evidence.title: GitHub - aryanvichare/stocks: 📈 Stock Picker using Next.js, React Server Components, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components and charts · GitHub

name: Stock Picker
summary: Demo web app that streams stock price data from the Polygon.io API into shadcn/ui charts using React Server Components.
description: A Next.js App Router demo that streams server-rendered stock price data from the Polygon.io API and renders it with the shadcn/ui charts library. Built with React Server Components, TypeScript, TailwindCSS and Shadcn/UI; clone it, add a Polygon.io API key and run the dev server.
contains: Next.js App Router demo app with React Server Components
streams server-rendered stock price data from the Polygon.io API
needs a Polygon.io API key in .env.local
